messages:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: service=redwood/inference-api, version=v2.3.4 -> 15% traffic in us-west-2 and eu-west-1. Change window 03/23 02:00-04:00 UTC. Release notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2.3.4. Reply with +1 to continue, or 'stop' to hold.
marie: +1. proceeding but watch latency and kvcache OOM signals. :thumbsup:
ajay: seeing p50 on /chat jump ~40ms in us-west-2 canary, small but noteworthy :eyes:
lin: confirmed in traces — increased redis fallback and kvcache miss rate in the same timeframe. correlates w/ higher queue depth for runtime-worker-7
marie: ok let's pause mechanistic ramp. hold at 15% for 10m while we validate. can we pin critical routes back to v2.3.3 in us-west-2?
ajay: i can apply route-level override. suggested minimal config: ```
route_override:
  - path: /chat
    version: v2.3.3
    scope: region:us-west-2
```
deploy-bot: Applying route-level pin for /chat in us-west-2... done.
sophia: noted — product update sent to release-notes (internal). small subset of API keys will route to v2.3.3, callouts added.
ajay: despite pin, tail p99 still slightly elevated for a subset. quick log snippet: ```
2026-03-23T02:12:18Z runtime-worker-7 WARN kvcache: eviction spike=312 ms keys_evicted=120
```
marie: decision: rollback targeted region or continue heatup? lin — your call on safety.
lin: recommend rollback for us-west-2 canary to v2.3.3. eu-west-1 can remain at 15% to gather more signals. i'll trigger a targeted rollback now.
marie: +1 rollback us-west-2. ops please prepare rollback note for customers impacted.
deploy-bot: Initiating targeted rollback: service=redwood/inference-api, region=us-west-2 -> target_version=v2.3.3
deploy-bot: Command executed: `/deploy rollback --service inference-api --region us-west-2 --target-version v2.3.3`
deploy-bot: Rollback completed at 1748355600. Traffic in us-west-2 routed back to v2.3.3. Monitoring for 5m.
ajay: monitoring now — metrics falling back to baseline. p50/p99 look normal again. thanks.
sophia: adding post-action to release notes: pinned /chat in us-west-2 and rolled back region; will reschedule canary after kvcache fix.
marie: closing thread — action items: 1) runtime investigate kvcache eviction root cause (ajay), 2) QA regen prompts to validate perf (sophia), 3) schedule reattempt after fix + preflight (marie). :heavy_check_mark:
